overview: This single-page State Department list of papers indexes a January 1944 communication concerning wartime administrative reorganization in Japan. The indexed item reports the creation of Japan’s Ministry of Transport and Communications on November 1, 1943, and provides information about the ministry’s organization and personnel.

subfiles.title: List of Papers entry on Japan’s Ministry of Transport and Communications
subfiles.from: International Bureau of the Telecommunication Union
subfiles.about: An index entry records a report on the creation, organization, and personnel of Japan’s Ministry of Transport and Communications.
subfiles.summary: The Department of State filing sheet identifies the subject as communications and transportation in Japan. Its sole entry describes a January 4, 1944, communication from the International Bureau of the Telecommunication Union concerning the ministry created on November 1, 1943. The indexed report supplied information on the ministry’s organization and personnel and was noted to another file reference, apparently “8-2002.”
keywords: International Bureau of the Telecommunication Union

interest: The page is useful as an archival roadmap rather than as the substantive report itself: it identifies a now-absent or separately filed communication about Japan’s wartime consolidation of transport and communications administration. Its precise creation date for the ministry, November 1, 1943, and its reference to organizational and personnel information may help historians trace bureaucratic restructuring and locate related State Department records.
